item.title: Binance Cyber Attack Points to North Korean Cyber Units
item.description: Experts suspect state-backed hackers from North Korea orchestrated a massive cryptocurrency theft. Validating these claims highlights the growing sophistication of Pyongyang's digital operations.

item.description: ফাতাহ ও হামাসের মধ্যকার চলমান দূরত্ব ফিলিস্তিনি রাজনৈতিক প্রতিষ্ঠানগুলোকে দুর্বল করেছে। এই অভ্যন্তরীণ বিভক্তির কারণে গাজা ও পশ্চিম তীরের জনগণের কষ্ট বহুগুণ বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে।

item.description: বাংলা আলোকচিত্রের ইতিহাসে কাজী নজরুল ইসলামের হাবিলদার পোশাকের প্রতিক্রেটটি একটি অনন্য স্টুডিও পোর্ট্রেট। এর শিল্পমান, ঐতিহাসিক তাৎপর্য ও প্রতীকী রূপ এটিকে একটি ক্লাসিক চিত্রে পরিণত করেছে।

item.title: সড়কপাশে ছাতিম ফুলের সুবাস
item.description: রাস্তার উভয়ধারে রয়েছে দুটি ছাতিমগাছ, যার শাখাগুলো ছাতার মতো ছড়ানো এবং এতে প্রচুর ফুল ফোটে। গাছতলায় টিনের চালে ঝরে পড়া ফুলের স্তূপ পথচারীদের দৃষ্টি কাড়ে।

item.description: বর্তমান বৈশ্বিক পরিস্থিতিতে এশিয়ার দেশগুলোর সঙ্গে সম্পর্ক গুরত্বপূর্ণ হয়ে উঠেছে। এর অংশ হিসেবে প্রধানমন্ত্রী তারেক রহমানের জাপান সফরকে কেন্দ্র করে অর্থনৈতিক খাতে বড় ধরনের প্রত্যাশা তৈরি হয়েছে।

item.title: US sentences two Chinese citizens for espionage
item.description: The US Justice Department announced that two men from China were imprisoned for conducting secret intelligence operations. Their illegal activities involved handling covert cash payments to obtain American national security secrets.

item.title: INDIA bloc organizes public impeachment event for CEC
item.description: The opposition alliance known as the INDIA bloc has scheduled a public impeachment event targeting Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Updates regarding this protest will be provided live.

item.title: Celebrity Traitors Concludes Second Season
item.description: The popular reality show wrapped up its second season on Friday. The finale followed a run that drew an audience of fifteen million viewers.

item.title: আলিম পরীক্ষার ফল প্রকাশের তারিখ ও পদ্ধতি
item.description: আগামী ৩১ অক্টোবর ২০২৬ তারিখে আলিম পরীক্ষার ফলাফল ঘোষণা করা হবে। পরীক্ষার্থীরা ইন্টারনেট এবং মোবাইল ফোনে এসএমএস পদ্ধতির মাধ্যমে নিজেদের ফলাফল জানতে পারবেন।

item.title: স্প্যানিশ লিগ ও রিয়ালের চীনমুখী নীতির কারণ
item.description: চীনের কঠোর মনোভাবের বিপরীতে রিয়াল মাদ্রিদ ও লা লিগার নমনীয় আচরণ অনেকের মনেই প্রশ্ন জাগিয়েছে। স্প্যানিশ এই প্রতিযোগিতাটির চীনা বাজারের ওপর অতিরিক্ত নির্ভরশীলতাই এর মূল কারণ।

item.title: Jaishankar comments on attacks on energy trade
item.description: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar stated that assaults on energy infrastructure and commerce are deliberate tactics to control market prices. He made these points during ongoing conflicts in West Asia and Ukraine.

item.title: PM Modi Commends ISRO Over NVS-03 Launch
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi praised the successful NVS-03 mission by ISRO. He stated that this achievement highlights the country's growing independence in essential technologies.

item.title: Gujarat High Court Puts Stay on Meat Sale Ban Order
item.description: On Friday, the Gujarat High Court halted a previous single-judge verdict that had lifted bans on non-vegetarian food sales near the Somnath temple pilgrimage paths. This decision quickly removes the legal relief previously given to local eateries.

item.title: New Social Security Board Formed for Gig and Unorganised Workers
item.description: The central government officially established the National Social Security Board for Unorganised Workers and Gig and Platform Workers on Friday. This move integrates gig personnel into formal institutional social security policy frameworks.

item.title: NCTE Establishes Committees to Update Teacher Hiring Rules
item.description: The National Council for Teacher Education formed two specialist panels in New Delhi to revise teacher hiring regulations. These committees will review eligibility guidelines for both the central and state teacher eligibility tests.

item.title: Chopper Crash Victims Scheduled to Fly Back to Bengaluru
item.description: A Bengaluru central crime branch inspector and four companions who died in a Friday helicopter crash in Joshimath, Uttarakhand, were scheduled to fly home that same evening.

item.title: Data Shows Unchanged Prices for Many Cancer Drugs
item.description: Recent government price caps on 137 non-scheduled cancer drugs lowered MRPs for 484 out of 643 medicine packs. However, nearly 25 percent of the listed medicine packages saw no price alterations.

item.title: International Biodiversity Summit Reaches Accord Despite Funding Dispute
item.description: Nations participating in global environmental negotiations successfully secured an agreement aimed at stopping biodiversity loss. Nevertheless, disagreements regarding financial support continue to persist.

item.title: Delhi Prepares Three-Year Protection Extension for Unauthorised Colonies
item.description: Delhi authorities are advancing a proposal to extend protections for unauthorised settlements by three years. This action addresses building safety worries and the low participation rate under the PM-UDAY regularisation initiative.

item.title: Top Court Revokes Bail for Former Lawmaker Anant Singh
item.description: Friday saw the Supreme Court revoke the bail previously given to ousted JD(U) politician Anant Singh in connection with the homicide of Jan Suraaj Party member Dularchand Yadav. He has been ordered to turn himself in by the first of December.

item.title: Pontiff Casts Ballot in American Midterm Elections
item.description: The Vatican has verified that the pope cast a mail-in vote from Chicago, his birthplace, preceding the upcoming midterm elections in November.

item.title: Bombay High Court Rules Activist Detention Unlawful
item.description: The Bombay High Court ordered Maharashtra authorities to pay activist Arun Ferreira two lakh rupees. The decision came after determining his constitutional rights under Articles 21 and 22 were breached during an arrest lacking proper identification.

item.title: Bogus Polls Highlight US Election System Flaws
item.description: Counterfeit surveys are intensifying strain amid an already highly divided political landscape in the United States leading up to the midterm elections.

item.title: Bystander Confronted With Firearm During ICE Operation
item.description: Video evidence reveals masked Immigration and Customs Enforcement personnel aiming a firearm at an individual walking dogs during a detention operation in North Hollywood, US.

item.title: TRAI Proposes Direct Reporting of AI Failures by Operators
item.description: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India suggested that major telecommunications providers must be held accountable for any malfunctions occurring within the artificial intelligence systems utilized across their networks.

item.title: Law enforcement deployed amid dispute involving Poland high court
item.description: Police officers were dispatched during a tense confrontation regarding management of a major Polish court. The situation intensified following government action to suspend two high-ranking judges and initiate criminal proceedings against them.

item.title: Court Calls for Heavier Penalties on Shared Video Clips
item.description: Authorities previously enforced a total prohibition on extracting, editing, sharing, or monetizing unauthorized video recordings taken from judicial proceedings.

item.title: Rafale Marine Jet Completes Initial Flight Tests on Carrier
item.description: Officials reported that a Rafale Marine fighter successfully executed its maiden landing and departure aboard the Indian Navy carrier INS Vikrant on Friday. This milestone occurs amidst ongoing evaluations prior to the official integration of the aircraft.

item.title: SC Rules Consensual Intimacy Post-Breakup Not Rape
item.description: On Friday, the Supreme Court ruled that a man cannot face rape charges simply because a consensual affair eventually ended and soured.

item.title: Mitchell Santner Sets T20 Record Against India
item.description: Mitchell Santner became the leading wicket-taker against India in T20 internationals after taking two wickets in the fourth match. He also reached a milestone of 150 career wickets.

item.title: Traveler Rushes to Catch Night Bus from Bandarban
item.description: With just three hours before an 8-hour bus departure from Bandarban and a prior evening meeting, a traveler packed a backpack and rushed off.

item.title: Author Reflects on Writing Twenty Books Using AI
item.description: An author expressed shock at online criticism labeling them lazy for using artificial intelligence to write twenty books over the past five to six years.

item.title: Sports Lineup Includes Mirpur Test and Premier League
item.description: Television broadcasts feature the fourth day of the Mirpur Test, the Cape Town Test, and a Premier League match between Chelsea and Manchester United.

item.title: Choosing Between Hot and Cold Compresses for Injury
item.description: Injuries often cause swelling and mobility issues, raising questions about whether to apply a hot compress or cold ice pack for the best relief.

item.title: Global Traditions Dedicated to Spirits and the Supernatural
item.description: Various cultures worldwide observe traditional festivals centered on departed souls, ancestral memories, and the supernatural, similar to Halloween.

item.title: Fishing Bans Imposed on the Yangtze River
item.description: Fishing is prohibited in the Yangtze River, a vital waterway that supports millions of people and serves as a habitat for rare aquatic species.

item.title: এইচএসসি পরীক্ষার ফল প্রকাশ আজ, নতুন নম্বরে এসএমএস পদ্ধতি
item.description: চলতি বছরের উচ্চ মাধ্যমিক সার্টিফিকেট বা এইচএসসি পরীক্ষা এবং সমমানের ফলাফল আজ প্রকাশ করা হবে। পরীক্ষার্থীরা তিনটি ভিন্ন মাধ্যমে তাদের ফলাফল জানতে পারবেন, যার মধ্যে নতুন একটি নম্বরের মাধ্যমে এসএমএস পাঠানোর নিয়ম অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে।

item.title: Strait of Hormuz: Tanker with 27 Indian crew hit by mines
item.description: A vessel carrying twenty-seven Indian nationals was damaged by limpet mines off the coast of Oman on Thursday. According to the British navy, the attack occurred 25 nautical miles northeast of Khasab, though a minister confirmed all crew members are unharmed.

item.title: Nvidia considers acting as cosigner for West Virginia AI center
item.description: Chip manufacturer Nvidia is reportedly considering acting as a loan cosigner for Nscale's artificial intelligence data center project located in West Virginia. This move comes as investors grow increasingly cautious regarding expenditures in the AI sector.

item.title: European diplomats avoid Russian delegation at US G20 meeting
item.description: European diplomats avoided Russian officials during a G20 event in the United States. Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov did not comment on the upcoming December summit, stating that Volodymyr Zelenskyy should visit Russia for talks with Vladimir Putin.

item.title: Delhi-NCR announces total construction ban from November 5 to 20
item.description: Delhi and its surrounding region will enforce a complete prohibition on building and demolition work from November 5 through November 20. Union environment minister Bhupender Yadav stated this step aims to address worsening winter air pollution.

item.title: Selma Blair breaks silence in tears following plane arrest incident
item.description: Actress Selma Blair addressed her recent aircraft-related arrest while in tears, stating she never meant to scare or harm anyone. She expressed remorse for any trouble caused and acknowledged the backing she received following the event.

item.title: Former corporate executive transforms chess landscape in North India
item.description: After leaving her high-paying corporate position to aid her daughter's chess goals, Nidhi Bhasin Rohilla identified infrastructure gaps in Delhi. She established a training academy, organized competitions, and built local player communities to fill the void.

item.title: Tamil Nadu tech professional heads team to revive village water
item.description: Motivated by a local gram sabha meeting, M Velmurugan established a civic group in Vellur, Tamil Nadu. The team collaborates with officials to tackle community issues, focusing on water access, burial grounds, and pollution reduction.

item.description: As reported by The Hindu, Surendar passed the interim order and listed the matter for hearing on November 25, 2026. Key points: High Court, Justice, Surendar, November.

item.title: US Approves Patriot Missile Sale to Ukraine
item.description: Washington has authorized the transfer of 500 Patriot interceptors to Ukraine. These American systems serve as the sole reliable defense against incoming Russian ballistic weapons.

item.title: 4 killed, 2 injured in fire at Delhi shoe factory; owner summoned
item.description: As reported by Times of India, A fire broke out at a shoe manufacturing factory in Delhi's Mangolpuri Industrial Area. Key points: Delhi, Mangolpuri Industrial Area, Firefighters, Sanjay Gandhi.

item.title: Jason Sanjay Alerts Public Regarding Imposter Social Media Profiles
item.description: Filmmaker Jason Sanjay issued an alert regarding fraudulent online accounts pretending to be him. He emphasized that he has not endorsed any fan clubs or authorized unauthorized pages.
